response.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS b FROM telescopes) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_of_station_averages, AVG(s.avg_usage - bl.b) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN baseline bl WHERE s.avg_usage > bl.b

assumptions.assumption: The baseline is the average of bandusagepct over all telescopes with a non-null value, where each telescope counts once. It is not the average of the station averages.
If no station is above the baseline, the query returns one row with NULL values.
